assistAttempts.changedStrategy: Attempted primary SEC filing retrieval rather than reusing the existing Beta risk narrative; external SEC fetch was unavailable in this execution path, so no duplicate artifact was emitted.

blockers.lawfulNextEvidencePath: Acquire source-addressed downside/execution-risk evidence from an accessible primary filing or issuer disclosure and let council-alpha incorporate it into numeric risk underwriting; council-beta must not create Alpha numeric risk or score.

learning.lesson: Existing Beta evidence already states the relevant commercialization, operating-loss, technical-milestone and revenue-recognition risks. Re-emitting those claims would add artifact volume without reducing Alpha's source-addressed risk-evidence gap.
learning.successCriterion: A materially new accessible primary source adds risk evidence that changes the assist input signature or enables council-alpha to close missing_score_risk_evidence.
